title: The War Named After A Bucket
description:
In 1325 the Italian city-states of Bologna and Modena fought a war that is named after a bucket. Bologna marched about 32,000 men against Modena's 7,000 and was routed at the Battle of Zappolino. Some accounts say the Modenese took a bucket from a well outside a Bolognese gate as a trophy; the popular story that a stolen bucket caused the war is mostly a myth, since the war was declared after Modena captured the castle of Monteveglio. The bucket was kept in Modena's tower, and the war inspired a mock-heroic poem and an opera.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'War of the Bucket'.
